item.name: Unit Collector I
item.requirement: Own 10 different units.
item.cardSummary: Early roster milestone that pays a small Gem and Gold claim once you have ten distinct units.

item.name: Unit Collector II
item.requirement: Own 30 different units.
item.cardSummary: Mid roster target for thirty unique units with a larger Gold payout than Collector I.

item.name: Unit Collector III
item.requirement: Own 45 different units.
item.cardSummary: Top unit-ownership milestone that grants strong Gem and Gold rewards plus the Collector title.

item.name: Summoner I
item.requirement: Summon 10 units.
item.cardSummary: First summon-count claim that unlocks naturally while pulling early banners.

item.name: Summoner II
item.requirement: Summon 50 units.
item.cardSummary: Mid summon grind for fifty pulls with a higher Gem payout than Summoner I.

item.name: Summoner III
item.requirement: Summon 100 units.
item.cardSummary: Hundred-summon milestone for the largest Collector summon Gem and Gold payout.

item.name: Category Completion
item.requirement: Complete all 6 The Collector achievements.
item.cardSummary: Category clear bonus after finishing every Collector achievement; one of the best Trait Crystal claims in the set.

item.name: The Hero's Journey
item.requirement: Reach the 3rd map node on Skull 3 difficulty on any map.
item.cardSummary: Expedition progress challenge for pushing to the third node on Skull 3, with Expedition Coins on top of Gems and Gold.

item.name: Maximum Output
item.requirement: Kill the Cursed Summoner Boss before he summons more than 3 times.
item.cardSummary: Boss-speed challenge that rewards heavy damage before the Cursed Summoner can summon a fourth time.

item.name: Meteoric Success
item.requirement: Hit the highest possible stat Rainbow Shard from an anvil.
item.cardSummary: Anvil forge challenge for rolling the top Rainbow Shard outcome during an Expedition run.

item.name: Elementalist
item.requirement: Obtain 9 different Elemental Cards within the same run, activating the 3rd tier Elementalism set.
item.cardSummary: Single-run Elemental Card set challenge that also pays Expedition Coins along with Gems and Gold.

item.name: Spirit City
item.requirement: Complete all acts of Spirit City.
item.exclusiveReward: Spirit City Banner, Savior of Society
item.cardSummary: Raid clear for every Spirit City act, with Trait Crystals plus both the Spirit City Banner and Savior of Society title.

item.name: Obtain 8th Sword
item.requirement: Obtain the Secret-rarity 8th Sword.
item.cardSummary: Secret-unit claim for pulling 8th Sword, with Trait Crystals, Gems, and the 8th Sword title.

item.name: Obtain Shadow
item.requirement: Obtain the Secret-rarity Shadow.
item.cardSummary: Secret-unit claim for pulling Shadow, rewarding Trait Crystals, Gems, and the Divine Controller title.

item.name: Secret Maniac
item.requirement: Summon the same Secret-rarity unit 3 times.
item.cardSummary: Duplicate Secret summon challenge that grants Trait Crystals, Gems, and the Secret Maniac title.

item.name: Rose Kingdom
item.requirement: Complete all acts of Rose Kingdom on Hard difficulty.
item.cardSummary: Hard Story clear for Rose Kingdom that pays Trait Crystals, Gems, and the Rose Kingdom profile banner.

item.name: Fairy King Forest
item.requirement: Complete all acts of Fairy King Forest on Hard difficulty.
item.cardSummary: Hard Story clear for Fairy King Forest with Trait Crystals, Gems, and the matching profile banner.

item.name: Flower Forest
item.requirement: Complete all acts of Flower Forest on Hard difficulty.
item.cardSummary: Hard Story clear for Flower Forest that unlocks Trait Crystals, Gems, and the Flower Forest Banner.

item.name: King's Tomb
item.requirement: Complete all acts of King's Tomb on Hard difficulty.
item.cardSummary: Hard Story clear for King's Tomb with Trait Crystals, Gems, and the Kings Tomb Banner.

item.name: School Grounds
item.requirement: Complete all acts of School Grounds on Hard difficulty.
item.cardSummary: Hard Story clear for School Grounds that grants Trait Crystals, Gems, and the School Grounds Banner.
